Can't do it, I beat this when there was nothing else on PC new, before the feast of varied titles that try new things, or the sea of classics from the genre finally being ported or remade for PC. I wanted to get 1.6 ago, at least 4/5 major updates of content (I think I finished just as Co-op was added before the island), give it a chance, but god this game is so boring, it meanders to nowhere and has done in a decade, it grabs whatever random popular trope from the genre it can...then does exactly NOTHING with it. It's like its afraid of the story having any meaning or teeth or point. It only ever clearly wanted to be a Harvest Moon clone and hasn't had a clear direction beyond that, in 2016 it was "fine", but we have choice, we have variety, we have games actually trying to be something different and not just an outdated trope from the 90s and endless Dark Souls like story telling of...leaving it to the fan base to do.

P.S. The praise this has got for diversity is exactly why it's in such a bad state in gaming, you all have rewarded non representation and non inclusion (in game and in life, inclusion includes hiring, paying people of the group you are profiting off) as the end goal.

Hate the combat, HATE the fishing, the mining is so boring when its not endlessly tense because of the sheer volume of stuff you need. Days are far to quick for a game with such large maps with big empty expanses of nothing all over the place. The plot (there isn't one really) goes no where, it's just bait, the characters and relationships are nothing, the occasional attempt at depth is without bite and without meaning and all just vanishes on marriage. There is no reason to play this game in 2026, not on PC, not when we have special additions of rune factory 3 and 4 (games that came out years prior to this one that "revolutionised the genre" by adding RPG elements), as well is 5 and Guardians of Azuma, on top of many remakes of classic Harvest moon titles under "Story of Seasons" now available, all that tell a complete story and have great farming mechanics. Frankly I don't see any appeal for Haunted Chocalatier (which is apparently the same universe but really seeks to further the larger narrative...not at all, that's just lazy sale bait) either, if it ever comes out, it looks to be more of the same random trope filled pointlessness. With a bad "art style" (not being bothered (his words), a shifting look that you can date when content was added by the sprites, is not a definitive art style or one anyone should be trying to emulate, if he respected art he'd hire someone to take some of the load from him, he has the wealth access and privilege to do so now, same with writing consultants for stories that are not his and he has no experience with to tell, only reason to not do so at this point is being an absolute control freak, or maybe he just enjoys the long since false myth of him being an island, a solo dev to much to let go) and same catching jingles, but they are just that jingles, not music.

I left this game running in the background a lot because I knew closing it would make me unkeen to click on this icon again to relaunch it, and that is exactly what happened, I closed it one day and have finished several other games since and just do not want to relaunch this one to be so bore by absolute overrated mediocrity that has been lionized in a totally undeserved manner (Actually seen this game be praised a communist narrative for the value of looking after yourself first....firstly those 2 things don't compute, secondly you spend the whole game fixing everyone elses petty problems when they had the power to do so themselves and just didn't, the hero worship is so beyond that people have bought into their own created myths). Just cause it's all you've played for the last 10 years doesn't make it original, doesn't make it the best in the genre and doesn't make it a good game. He just took good advantage of a gap in the market that other devs didn't see the value in (and that is something he certainly has shown them)

Unless you are morbidly curious of what its like to be bored out of your mind by stories that go nowhere, just don't, you are so overloaded with options.
